maizium, maiziī n.

noun, second declension

Recorded in Morgan–Owens. This is an early modern Latin borrowing, not Classical vocabulary. The borrowing ultimately reflects Taíno through Spanish. Scientific name: Zea mays. Botanical names are given in their conventional spelling. The source establishes the word, not all its stem vowel lengths. Only the certain Latin inflectional quantity is marked in maiziī.
